invalidated_claim: A quantitatively strong rank-two original-coordinate cross bicore, together with a nonzero invertible indefinite physical pair, forces a quantitatively nondegenerate rank-two cross bicore in the exact post-pair Schur complement when overlap couplings are unrestricted.
counterexample: For flat orthonormal two-frames U,V, H0=[[0,1],[1,0]], B=eps H0, K=sigma U V^T and c^2=sigma eps, take pair-to-bank couplings cU and c V H0. The full matrix has nonzero spectrum {-a,-sigma,-b,b,sigma,a}, with a>sigma, hence is target-valid for sigma>=1 and can be made strict N3.
